newsitem.title: USA: USDA -- world supply and demand report out June 12.
newsitem.headline: USDA -- world supply and demand report out June 12.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Wednesday said it would release its monthly world supply and demand report on schedule at 0830 EDT/1230 GMT on June 12 despite a security breach at a department website.
USDA's Foreign Agricultural Service shut down access to its internet home page Tuesday after an unknown party broke into the system and began sending messages onto the internet.
There was market speculation the department would delay release of the key world crop report because the hacker may have accessed some of the data.

"There's no truth in that rumour at all," said David Stallings, economist at the World Agricultural Outlook Board, which puts out the report. "The FAS home page has nothing to do with production of the WASDE report."

"I just can't visualize anything other than its a slow news day and rumours like this come across," said Rich Allen, chairperson of the agricultural statistics board. "We're definitely going to go ahead with crop production and the WASDE reports tomorrow."
Department officials also said they would release the weekly export sales report as scheduled at 0830 EDT/1230 GMT on Thursday.
